description: How the marketplace roles relate to each other: who publishes listings for whom, how buyers contact and pay sellers and merchants, and how integration partners contract with and syndicate for professional supply.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Integration contracts and merchant service agreements

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day contacting, lead handling, and feed syndication

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Purchase payments and integration service fees

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Listings, storefront promotion, and integration feedback

relations.name: Publishes listings for discovery
relations.description: Posts used goods, vehicles, and services with photos and honest details that buyers find through browse, search, and saved alerts.

relations.name: Promotes storefront inventory
relations.description: Keeps large, refreshed inventories and paid-visibility campaigns in front of buyers through storefronts and category search.

relations.name: Contacts and negotiates
relations.description: Messages casual sellers to ask questions, negotiate price, and arrange a meetup or shipping, expecting real people and quick replies.

relations.name: Sends qualified leads
relations.description: Generates enquiries, test-drive requests, and callbacks that merchants triage and convert through their lead-management workflow.

relations.name: Pays for local purchases
relations.description: Pays casual sellers in person or through the marketplace's secure payment and shipping flow, which protects both sides of the deal.

relations.name: Purchases from merchants
relations.description: Completes higher-value purchases from professional sellers, paying via trusted checkout or financing arranged off the back of a listing.

relations.name: Contracts integration services
relations.description: Sells merchants an inventory-management stack with marketplace connectivity built in, contracting to keep their listings flowing to the platform.

relations.name: Syndicates inventory feeds
relations.description: Pushes merchant inventory through validated API and feed integrations, handling mapping and validation errors so listings publish reliably at scale.

relations.name: Pays integration subscription fees
relations.description: Pays the SaaS partner recurring fees for feed management and lead routing, expecting low support overhead and stable syndication in return.
